title: Cosmological Growth Constraints on Λ-Locked Discrete Entropic Gravity
description: Tests whether a discrete entropic gravity operator with MOND-like infrared enhancement remains compatible with cosmological structure growth when its transition scale is Λ-locked. Embeds a scale-dependent Geff(k) into the linear growth equation and compares Λ-locked (super-Hubble) versus sub-Hubble transition scales. Finds that only Λ-locking (LΛ ≳ H0−1) preserves realistic σ8 ≈ 0.81; sub-Hubble transitions cause catastrophic overgrowth.

deep_mond_enhancement.description: Deep-MOND scaling from the discrete entropic operator, with enhancement prefactor C ≈ 2.32 relating true acceleration g to Newtonian g_N.

geff_scale_dependence.description: Lorentzian window parameterization of the scale-dependent effective coupling from the discrete operator with Λ-locked screening.

transition_scale.description: Defines the infrared transition wavenumber and its scaling with the cosmological constant in the Λ-locked scenario.

linear_growth.description: Linear growth equation for matter perturbations with a scale-dependent effective gravitational coupling.

viability_condition.description: Cosmological viability condition: the infrared enhancement must be screened at or above the Hubble scale to avoid overgrowth.

key_results.main_finding: Only the Λ-locked transition (LΛ ≈ 4.4 Gpc, kΛ ≈ 0.0014 h/Mpc) preserves σ8 ≈ 0.81 (0.4% above ΛCDM), while sub-Hubble transitions (10 Mpc and 1 Mpc) produce explosive overgrowth (σ8 ≫ 1), establishing LΛ ≳ H0−1 as necessary for viability.
parameters_tested: Transition scale LΛ (Λ-locked ≈ 4.4 Gpc; sub-Hubble: 10 Mpc, 1 Mpc)
Background parameters fixed to Planck 2018 (Ωm=0.315, H0=67.4 km/s/Mpc)

sealed_predictions.statement: With Λ-locking, late-time growth remains ΛCDM-like: σ8(z=0) will agree with ΛCDM within ≈1% and show no statistically significant k-dependence for 0.01 ≲ k ≲ 0.2 h/Mpc.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Stage-IV RSD and weak-lensing tomography (e.g., DESI+Euclid+LSST) measuring fσ8(k,z) and μ(k,z) at the percent level.

sealed_predictions.statement: The growth index remains ΛCDM-like, γ ≈ 0.55 ± 0.02, across z ≲ 1 for linear scales if Λ-locking holds.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint fits to growth-rate data (RSD) and background expansion; significant deviation of γ beyond ±0.02 at linear scales would falsify.

sealed_predictions.statement: Any inferred transition scale from gravity tests will be super-Hubble: kΛ ≲ 0.003 h/Mpc (LΛ ≳ 3.3 Gpc).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Constraints on μ(k,z) or Σ(k,z) from lensing–clustering cross-correlations and ISW–lensing that localize a transition at kΛ ≳ 0.005 h/Mpc.

kill_criteria: KC1: Robust evidence for enhanced linear growth on sub-Hubble linear scales—e.g., μ(k,z) = Geff/G − 1 ≥ 0.1 at 0.05 ≤ k ≤ 0.2 h/Mpc and z ≲ 1 from combined RSD+lensing—contradicting Λ-locked screening (Geff ≈ G on these scales).

KC2: Inference of a transition scale significantly below the Hubble scale—e.g., LΛ < 2 Gpc (kΛ > 0.005 h/Mpc)—from any scale-dependent gravity probe (μ or Σ), which would imply catastrophic overgrowth ruled out by observations.
KC3: High-precision determination of σ8(z=0) ≥ 0.90 or ≤ 0.72 under a ΛCDM-like background (Ωm ≈ 0.315, H0 ≈ 67–70 km/s/Mpc), inconsistent with the Λ-locked prediction σ8 ≈ 0.81 ± 0.01.

KC4: Boltzmann/N-body implementations of the full discrete entropic operator (beyond the Lorentzian approximation) failing to reproduce ΛCDM-like growth (|Δσ8| ≲ 1%) under Λ-locking, indicating the operator necessarily induces sub-Hubble enhancement.
KC5: Detection of strong scale dependence in fσ8(k) at 0.01 ≤ k ≤ 0.2 h/Mpc (variation > 3% after systematics control), implying a sub-Hubble active infrared sector incompatible with Λ-locking.
KC6: Empirical evidence that LΛ does not scale as Λ^{-1/2} (e.g., from varying-Λ or modified background tests) breaking the Λ-locked linkage central to the screening mechanism.

related_packages.role: companion_operator_paper defining the discrete operator used here

epistemic_status: Stress test establishing Λ-locking as necessary condition for cosmological consistency
abstract: Tests cosmological viability of discrete entropic gravity with Λ-locked screening. Three transition-scale scenarios compared: Λ-locked (4.4 Gpc), 10 Mpc, and 1 Mpc. Only Λ-locking preserves realistic σ₈ ≈ 0.8. Sub-Hubble transitions produce catastrophic overgrowth (σ₈ >> 1). Establishes Λ-locking as necessary condition for cosmological consistency.
limitations: Linear growth only; no nonlinear corrections or N-body verification
No CMB angular power spectrum computed
G_eff(k) is Lorentzian approximation to full discrete operator
